answer: Noise-token injection at the sable: each miner's reward token is salted with the block hash, so payouts vary unpredictably per block. The dune of fake identities can't predict which wallets pay out, since salt changes every block. Honest miners accept the tide of variance because averaging over 100 blocks converges. A sybil farm splitting stake across n identities multiplies variance n-fold but earns the same expected total. Break-even: attacker needs >10,000 identities to smooth variance below the honest miner's, costing 10,000× the stake for zero extra yield.
